transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. What brings you here today?

Mostly I’m here because I’m just really tired. Like, not normal tired—sleep doesn’t seem to fix it. Even little things, like unloading the dishwasher or trying to read for my certificate class, feel like too much sometimes.
Have you noticed that you’re not enjoying things that you used to find pleasurable, like hobbies, time with friends, or even activities you used to look forward to?

Yeah, I have. I’ve kind of stopped caring about the things that usually make me feel like myself. I haven’t been sketching, I skip gallery openings, I don’t really feel like cooking or going to yoga… even playing tennis with a friend feels like too much or just not interesting.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day, for at least the past two weeks?
Yeah… I’d say so. It’s been this quieter low stretch for about three months now, where most days I feel pretty down and just not interested in much. The fatigue has been a big part of it too.
Have you ever had a period like this before, where you felt down and lost interest in things, or is this the first time you've felt this way?
I’m not really sure. I know I’ve had low patches before, but I don’t know if they were like this or lasted this long. This one feels more noticeable to me.
Have you ever had a period lasting at least two weeks where you felt down and lost interest in things, before this current time?

I’m honestly not sure. I’ve had times where I felt low before, but I can’t really say if it was at least two weeks with both feeling down and losing interest like this. This current one is the clearest to me.
Can you think back and recall if there was a time before this current episode where you felt down or lost interest in things for at least two weeks?

I really can’t recall clearly. I’ve had times before where I felt low or kind of checked out, but I don’t know if it lasted two full weeks or was the same as this. This current stretch is the one I can really identify.
Can you remember if there was a time before this current episode when you felt down and lost interest in things for at least two weeks in a row?

I don’t think I can say for sure. I remember feeling down at different times before, but I can’t clearly remember a stretch where it was both being down and not enjoying things for two weeks straight.
Looking back, can you say for certain that you’ve had a time before this current episode where you felt down and lost interest in things for at least two weeks straight?
No, I can’t say that for certain. I’ve had low times before, but I don’t remember clearly enough to say it was two weeks straight with both feeling down and losing interest.
Before this current episode, have you ever had a time when you felt down and lost interest in things for at least two weeks in a row?
I’m not sure. I remember having periods where I felt low before, but I can’t say clearly that it was both feeling down and losing interest for two weeks in a row.

I really can’t say for sure. I know I’ve had times before where I felt pretty low, but I don’t remember it clearly enough to say it was both feeling down and losing interest for a full two weeks like this.
